title: Insurance Claim Services Withdrawal Terms Extract
content:
Extract of the withdrawal terms of each Insurance Claim Services arrangement: how long after signing the insured may withdraw the arrangement, and whether withdrawal is still open once work on the loss has been authorized.

- **Withdrawal window** — calendar days after the instrument is signed within which the insured may withdraw the arrangement, count.
- **Withdrawal after work allowed** — whether the arrangement may be withdrawn after any job of the claim file has been authorized, boolean.

| Arrangement | Withdrawal window (calendar days) | Withdrawal after work allowed |
|---|---|---|
| Homeowner Direct Pay Claim Support | 30 | yes |
| Direction to Pay Claim Billing | 30 | yes |
| Assignment of Benefits Claim Billing | 14 | no |
| Carrier Program Claim Billing | 7 | no |
| Public Adjuster Coordinated Claim Billing | 30 | yes |
| Commercial Large Loss Claim Administration | 14 | no |

The three arrangements that close withdrawal once work is authorized are Assignment of Benefits Claim Billing, Carrier Program Claim Billing and Commercial Large Loss Claim Administration. Carrier Program Claim Billing has the shortest window, 7 days.
